name: James Riley
role: Medora resident who raised money for the school
bio: James Riley and Mr. Coleman circulated a petition in November 1884 that raised enough money to open a Medora school at the Cantonment, and in March 1886 he and Mr. Garver ran a contribution box to keep the school going. In October 1886 the paper reported him back in charge at the tank-house.

moments.label: Raised subscriptions to open a Medora school

mentions: …ng is a list of the subscribers to the school fund collected by Messrs. Coleman and Riley: M. M. Coleman, $5; James Riley, $3; John Goodall, $1; W. P. Osterhaut, $1; A. T. Packard, $1; Patrick O'Hara, $3; L. C. Luke, $1; Charles Cook, $1; T. Martin, Robert Roberts, $1; J. M. Hannigan,…

A petition for the establishment of a school was circulated yesterday by Messrs. Coleman and Riley, and enough money subscribed to guarantee its opening. Dan Williams will be teacher, and the school will open next Monday morning at the Cantonment.
Messrs. Garver and Riley's contribution box for the benefit of the school, panned out fairly well, last week. The school will probably be continued for two months at least.
Things at the tank-house look more natural with Jas. Riley at the helm.
